##### Decision Variables

$x_i \ge 0$: quantity of product $i$ to sell, $i \in I$.

##### Objective Function

$\max \sum_{i\in I} r_i x_i$

##### Constraints

1. Demand satisfaction: $x_i \le d_i,\quad \forall i\in I$.
2. Inventory limitation: $x_i \le I_i,\quad \forall i\in I$.
3. Nonnegativity: $x_i \ge 0,\quad \forall i\in I$.
